metadata.author: Momma Bear Audio
metadata.description:
Turn your home into an exciting scavenger hunt adventure! Build Your Own Scavenger Hunt allows grown-ups to create a completely customized hunt using a variety of fun themes and hiding locations. Whether you’re planning a birthday surprise, hiding a Yoto card, creating a candy hunt, or simply adding some excitement to an ordinary day, this flexible audio makes it easy to create a unique experience again and again.How to Use:Download the MP3 files and create a playlist on the Yoto MYO website or Tonies Creative website. Start by selecting an intro track that matches your hunt theme. Available themes include Birthday (Any Object Hunt), Birthday (Yoto Card Hunt), Candy Hunt, Yoto Card Hunt, and Generic Hunt.Next, choose the location tracks that match the places where you’ve hidden your surprises. Add as many or as few locations as you’d like to create the perfect length hunt. Finish your playlist with the matching outro track.For the best experience, set each track to “Wait for Button Press” in the Yoto app so players must find each hidden item before moving on to the next clue. Many families find it helpful to number their location tracks in order.With dozens of hiding locations and multiple themes, this scavenger hunt can be used again and again for birthdays, holidays, rewards, special surprises, and everyday fun!Please note: This audio does not come with a Yoto Link as you will need to build your own. There are multiple clues for each hiding location and multiple intros and outros. This audio does not work as a standalone scavenger hunt.

Looking for other free audio sources, ideas and inspo? Maybe you want to submit a request for some sort of specific audio for your kids? Join my FB Group! I am always taking suggestions and working to get the audio your kids want.
